name: ToggleSwitch
statusNote: Stable in use; alpha is Primer's label. Its CSS still carries fallbacks to the retired --color-switch-* palette, a sign the component predates the controlTrack and controlKnob tokens.
summary: An on/off switch for a setting that takes effect immediately, with a visible 'On'/'Off' status label beside the track. Choose Checkbox when the choice is submitted later with a form; label it with a visible element whose id the switch names.

inputs.name: ariaLabelledby
inputs.description: The id of the visible text that names the switch. The switch has no label of its own; 'On'/'Off' is its state, not its name.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.description: On or off. Controlled when given (the caller must update it from onChange); otherwise defaultChecked seeds it.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: Called with the requested new state on each toggle.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Called after onChange on each accepted press.

inputs.name: statusLabelPosition
inputs.description: Status label before the track (start) or after it (end). Change it only to align the switch with content above or below.

inputs.name: buttonLabelOn
inputs.description: Status text while on; customise only for a more specific word (Show, Enabled).

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Ignore input and draw the disabled look.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: The value is being saved: show a small spinner, ignore input, draw the disabled look, and announce loadingLabel after a delay.

inputs.name: loadingLabelDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds of loading before loadingLabel is announced.

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.description: An inline row, items centred: spinner (while loading), status label, track; reversed when the label is at the end.

anatomy.name: Status label
anatomy.description: The current state's word ('On' or 'Off') in --fgColor-default, body text at the switch's size, right-aligned, with 8px on both sides. Both words occupy the box so it is as wide as the wider one.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: A 64 by 32px (48 by 24px small) rounded rectangle, 1px border, --borderRadius-default (6px, not a pill), clipping its contents.

anatomy.name: On icon
anatomy.description: A vertical line glyph (16px, 12px small) centred in the track's left half, in --control-checked-fgColor-rest; visible while on.

anatomy.name: Off icon
anatomy.description: A ring glyph (16px, 12px small) centred in the track's right half, in --controlTrack-fgColor-rest; visible while off.

anatomy.name: Knob
anatomy.description: A half-track-wide rounded rectangle inset 1px in the track: --controlKnob-bgColor-rest fill, 1px border, radius --borderRadius-default less --borderWidth-thick (4px); it slides to the end when on.

anatomy.name: Loading spinner
anatomy.description: A 16px Spinner before the status label (8px after the label when the label is at the end).

variants.description: Track 64 by 32px, 16px glyphs, medium body status text.
Track 48 by 24px, 12px glyphs, small body status text.
Track, label, then spinner (the row reversed).

layout.text: The track is a fixed 64 by 32px at medium and 48 by 24px at small, border included; its corners are --borderRadius-default (6px).

The knob sits 1px inside the track's border on top, bottom and start, is 50% of the track's inner width, and translates by its own width less 2px when on, so it rests 1px from either end. At medium that is a 31 by 28px knob moving 29px; at small 23 by 20px moving 21px.
The knob's corner radius is --borderRadius-default minus --borderWidth-thick (4px), so it nests inside the track's 6px corner.

Inside the track, a row holds two equal halves at full height; the line glyph is centred in the left half and the ring glyph in the right half (the button's default centred text alignment). The knob is drawn above both.

The status label has 8px on both sides and stacks both words, the inactive one invisible and zero-height, so its width is the wider of the two words and does not change on toggle; text is right-aligned in that width.
The root is an inline row with items centred vertically; statusLabelPosition end reverses it, and the spinner then gets an 8px start margin.

states.text: Off: track --controlTrack-bgColor-rest with --controlTrack-borderColor-rest border; knob at the start, --controlKnob-bgColor-rest with --controlKnob-borderColor-rest; ring glyph showing in --controlTrack-fgColor-rest.

On: track --control-checked-bgColor-rest with --control-checked-borderColor-rest border; knob at the end with --controlKnob-borderColor-checked border; line glyph showing in --control-checked-fgColor-rest.
Track fill only: --controlTrack-bgColor-hover when off, --control-checked-bgColor-hover when on. Keyboard focus applies the same fill.
Track fill only: --controlTrack-bgColor-active when off, --control-checked-bgColor-active when on.
Keyboard focus: the --focus-outline outline (2px solid in the focus colour) 3px outside the track, plus the hover fill. A pointer press leaves a transparent 1px outline, invisible.

Track --controlTrack-bgColor-disabled with a transparent border; knob --controlKnob-bgColor-disabled bordered in --controlTrack-bgColor-disabled; line glyph --control-checked-fgColor-disabled, ring glyph --controlTrack-fgColor-disabled; status text --fgColor-muted; not-allowed cursor; no transitions. The same look whether on or off.
A 16px spinner appears in the row, input is ignored, and the switch draws its disabled look (loading and disabled share one flag).

behaviour.text: A press on the track or on the status label toggles the switch, unless disabled or loading. Uncontrolled, it flips its own state and calls onChange; controlled, it only calls onChange with the opposite of checked and waits for the caller. onClick follows.

The knob and both glyphs slide (the on glyph from one half-width off the start, the off glyph towards the end), and the track's fill and border fade, over 80ms cubic-bezier(0.5, 1, 0.89, 1). Under reduced motion all of it is instant.
The status label switches word at once, without animation.
While loading, loadingLabel is announced through a status region after loadingLabelDelay (2000ms by default) and the switch is described by it; it clears when loading ends.

accessibility.role: button with aria-pressed (a toggle button, not role switch)
keyboard: Tab focuses it, even when disabled or loading.
semantics: Name from aria-labelledby; the On/Off status text is aria-hidden.
aria-pressed true when on, false when off.
aria-disabled true when disabled or loading; it stays focusable.
While loading, after the delay, aria-describedby names the loading status (plus any caller description).

notes.text: The status label must be laid out at the width of the wider of its two words, measured before layout, so the track does not shift when toggled; Primer gets this by stacking both words with the inactive one invisible and zero-height.
The track is a rounded rectangle at --borderRadius-default (6px), not a pill; foundations' list of --borderRadius-full users names ToggleSwitch, but the module does not read --borderRadius-full.
Loading uses the disabled look and aria-disabled; a loading switch cannot be told from a disabled one except by the spinner.
primer.style says a disabled ToggleSwitch has the disabled attribute; the code sets only aria-disabled, so it stays focusable and in the tab order.
It is announced as a toggle button (aria-pressed), not a switch; keep that role in a native accessibility tree for parity, or use the platform's switch role knowingly.
The glyphs are centred in their halves only because a <button> centres its text by default; a native build centres them explicitly.
For a coarse pointer an invisible layer at least 44px tall, full track width, is centred on the track to enlarge the hit target vertically; the visual size does not change.

Track sizes, the 1px knob inset, the 2px knob travel correction, the 3px focus offset, the 80ms duration and its curve are literals; --toggleSwitch-transition-* are module-local variables, not tokens.

Every colour has a fallback to a retired --color-switch-* variable or a literal (#eaeef2, #0969da...); the controlTrack, controlKnob and control-checked tokens always resolve, so the fallbacks never apply.
Under forced colours a disabled track borders in GrayText and a disabled knob's colour is GrayText.
